title: Onboard an API to Apigee
summary: Publish a backend API through the Apigee gateway: design review, proxy configuration, test deployment and production approval.

prerequisites.title: GCP project for the backend
prerequisites.description: The backend must already run in a company GCP project.

prerequisites.title: OpenAPI 3 specification
prerequisites.description: A spec that passes the company API linting rules.

prerequisites.title: Backend reachable from Apigee
prerequisites.description: Private connectivity or an allow-listed endpoint in the test environment.

actors.name: You
actors.description: The engineer or BA following this process.

actors.name: Deployment pipeline
actors.description: CI/CD that deploys proxies to Apigee.

steps.title: Register the API
instructions: Enter the API name, owner team and application ID.
State the consumers: internal, partner or public.

steps.title: Hold the API design review
steps.description: The API Platform team walks through the spec with you: naming, versioning, authentication and rate limits.

steps.title: Update the specification
instructions: Apply the review comments to the OpenAPI spec.
Attach the new version to the onboarding ticket.

steps.title: Create the proxy configuration
instructions: Generate the proxy skeleton with the apigee-template CLI.
Set the target endpoint for test and prod.
Add the standard policies: OAuth verification, quota, spike arrest.

steps.title: Test the API through the gateway
instructions: Request a test client ID in the developer portal.
Call every operation through the test gateway URL.
Check authentication, quota and error responses.

steps.title: Request production release
instructions: Raise a standard change 'Apigee proxy release'.

steps.title: Approve the production release
steps.description: Security checks authentication, data classification and exposure.

steps.title: Announce the API to consumers
instructions: Publish the API product in the developer portal.
